# Dogan Teke

> Dogan Teke is a fullstack developer and frontend engineer based in Germany. He builds modern web products with a frontend-first mindset, combining Vue, Nuxt, TypeScript, scalable architecture, product thinking, and practical AI integrations. His public GitHub username is laflamme.

## Professional profile

Dogan Teke studied at the University of Cologne and has more than six years of professional experience building modern web applications. His work has a strong frontend focus while extending into backend development, infrastructure, architecture, technical review, and production delivery.

His primary stack includes Vue.js, Nuxt, TypeScript, JavaScript, component-driven architecture, design systems, accessibility, performance, and complex product workflows. His broader fullstack experience includes PHP, Python, Node.js, databases, Docker, CI/CD, and API development.

He uses AI pragmatically for product features, developer workflows, structured content processing, prompt systems, and AI-assisted interfaces. AI is treated as an implementation capability rather than a substitute for product judgment, maintainable architecture, or interaction design.

## Current work

Dogan Teke works as a fullstack developer at denkwerk GmbH. His responsibilities include complex client applications, Vue and Nuxt platforms, multi-step flows, streaming features, secure access, payments, Apple Wallet integrations, design systems, Storybook component libraries, internal packages, reviews, onboarding, performance, accessibility, and cross-functional delivery.

Previous professional roles include fullstack development at Actineo GmbH and frontend development and platform consulting at IMV GmbH & Co. KG.

## Independent products

### GrillMe

- **Live product:** [https://grillme.dev](https://grillme.dev)
- **Source:** [https://github.com/lafllamme/grill-me](https://github.com/lafllamme/grill-me)
- **Portfolio case:** [https://teke.studio/projects/grillme](https://teke.studio/projects/grillme)

GrillMe is an AI-supported developer feedback product created by Dogan Teke. It turns public GitHub activity into structured, humorous feedback. The work combines product design, Vue/Nuxt frontend engineering, Cloudflare Workers AI, prompt systems, and AI interaction design.

### Tecnews

- **Live product:** [https://tecnews.dev](https://tecnews.dev)
- **Portfolio case:** [https://teke.studio/projects/tecnews](https://teke.studio/projects/tecnews)

Tecnews is an AI-supported editorial product created by Dogan Teke for curated developer news and technical reading. It combines verified-source aggregation, issue-based discovery, editorial UX, frontend engineering, and motion systems.

### Codex Theme Studio

- **Live product:** [https://codex-theme.pages.dev](https://codex-theme.pages.dev)
- **Source:** [https://github.com/lafllamme/codex-themes](https://github.com/lafllamme/codex-themes)

Codex Theme Studio is a browser-based TypeScript and Vue application for building, previewing, and exporting theme packs for OpenAI Codex.
